SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='G0483') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount),0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT p.payer_class, rc.payment_date - p.first_sub AS d FROM p JOIN sem.remit_claims rc
  ON rc.claim_key=p.claim_key AND rc.payer_key=p.payer_key AND rc.is_current_adjudication AND rc.paid_amount>0)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) paid_claims, round(quantile_cont(d,0.5),1) median_days, round(quantile_cont(d,0.9),1) p90_days
FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT a.claim_key||'|'||a.payer_key) denied_claims
FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN sem.remit_claims rc ON rc.remit_claim_id=a.remit_claim_id
WHERE rc.is_current_adjudication AND rc.is_denied AND a.group_code='CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

WITH e AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, count(*) n,
  bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) pairs_remitted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n=1 AND ok) first_pass_resolved,
 round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE n=1 AND ok)/count(*),2) rate_pct FROM e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH e AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) nt,
  bool_or(is_reversal) has_rev, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) has_cur,
  coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication),0) paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_rev) with_reversal, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_cur) no_current,
 round(coalesce(sum(paid),0),2) current_paid FROM e WHERE nt>=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

SELECT sum(a.adjustment_amount) FROM sem.adjustments a
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code='PR' AND a.carc_code='1'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.claims c WHERE c.claim_key=a.claim_key AND c.payer_key=a.payer_key AND c.payer_responsibility='P')

WITH c AS (SELECT date_trunc('month',service_date_from)::date m, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_date_from>=DATE '2026-06-01'),
r AS (SELECT m, referring_npi, count(*) n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m ORDER BY count(*) DESC, referring_npi) rk FROM c GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT m AS month, sum(n) total_claims, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5) top5_claims, round(100.0*sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5)/sum(n),1) top5_share_pct FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='87798') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount),0), 4) AS share

WITH cur AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication),
cp AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines UNION SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.remit_lines)
SELECT procedure_code, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied), round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied)/count(*),2) r FROM cur JOIN cp USING(claim_key) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=20 ORDER BY 4 DESC,1

WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'),
j AS (SELECT CASE WHEN l.line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE l.line_count::varchar END bucket, rc.is_denied, l.charge_amount
  FROM p JOIN sem.remit_claims rc ON rc.claim_key=p.claim_key AND rc.payer_key=p.payer_key AND rc.is_current_adjudication JOIN l ON l.claim_key=p.claim_key)
SELECT bucket, count(*) claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) denied, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied)/count(*),2) rate_pct,
 coalesce(sum(charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_denied),0) denied_charge FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount amt FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code='FB'),
x AS (SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date cd, round(-c.amt,2) amount,
 (SELECT min(o.payment_date) FROM f o WHERE o.payer_key=c.payer_key AND o.reference_id=c.reference_id AND o.amt=-c.amt AND o.payment_date>c.payment_date) od FROM f c WHERE c.amt<0)
SELECT reference_id, cd carried_forward_date, amount, od offset_date, od-cd days FROM x ORDER BY cd, reference_id

WITH t AS (SELECT payer_class, payment_month m, sum(paid_amount) paid FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1,2),
s AS (SELECT payer_class, 100.0*sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE m=DATE '2026-07-01')/(SELECT sum(paid) FROM t WHERE m=DATE '2026-07-01') jul,
  100.0*sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE m=DATE '2026-08-01')/(SELECT sum(paid) FROM t WHERE m=DATE '2026-08-01') aug FROM t GROUP BY 1)
SELECT payer_class, round(jul,1) jul_share, round(aug,1) aug_share, round(aug-jul,1) change_pp FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) rep FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' AND frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
o AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) orig FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='1' GROUP BY 1,2),
j AS (SELECT r.*, o.orig, rc.payment_date pd, rc.paid_amount FROM r LEFT JOIN o USING (claim_key,payer_key)
  LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims rc ON rc.claim_key=r.claim_key AND rc.payer_key=r.payer_key AND rc.is_current_adjudication AND rc.payment_date>=r.rep)
SELECT count(*) claims, round(avg(rep-orig),2) avg_days_to_replacement, count(pd) paid_after, round(avg(pd-orig),2) avg_days_to_payment,
 coalesce(sum(paid_amount),0) total_paid FROM j

WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) voided, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount>0 AND r.payment_date<v.vd)) paid_before,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date>=v.vd)) reversed,
 round(coalesce((SELECT sum(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.claim_key IN (SELECT claim_key FROM v)),0),2) current_paid FROM v
SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount=0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH r AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) rep FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
f AS (SELECT r.payer_class, r.claim_key, min(rc.payment_date)-r.rep d FROM r JOIN sem.remit_claims rc ON rc.claim_key=r.claim_key AND rc.payer_key=r.payer_key AND rc.payment_date>=r.rep GROUP BY r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.rep)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) corrected_claims, round(avg(d),1) avg_days, min(d) min_days, max(d) max_days FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING bool_or(is_reversal) AND NOT bool_or(is_current_adjudication))

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='80307') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount),0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) fs FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT p.*, (SELECT min(payment_date) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key) fr FROM p WHERE fs BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31')
SELECT payer_class, count(*) cohort_claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr-fs<=14) within_14, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr-fs<=14)/count(*),1) pct FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='G0482') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount),0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH r AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) rep FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2),
d AS (SELECT r.* FROM r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=r.claim_key AND x.payer_key=r.payer_key AND x.claim_status_code='4' AND x.payment_date<r.rep)),
o AS (SELECT d.*, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=d.claim_key AND x.payer_key=d.payer_key AND x.payment_date>=d.rep) after_remit,
  (SELECT any_value(is_denied) FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=d.claim_key AND x.payer_key=d.payer_key AND x.is_current_adjudication) cur_denied,
  (SELECT sum(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims x WHERE x.claim_key=d.claim_key AND x.payer_key=d.payer_key AND x.is_current_adjudication) paid FROM d)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT after_remit THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN cur_denied IS FALSE THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END outcome,
 count(*) claims, round(coalesce(sum(paid),0),2) total_paid FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2
  HAVING bool_or(adjudication_state='superseded' AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied) AND bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied))
SELECT count(*) overturned, coalesce(sum(rc.paid_amount),0) total_paid FROM p JOIN sem.remit_claims rc USING (claim_key,payer_key) WHERE rc.is_current_adjudication

WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, frequency_code, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission),
p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) fs FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2),
o AS (SELECT p.*, l.charge_amount, DATE '2026-08-14'-p.fs age FROM p JOIN l USING (claim_key) WHERE l.frequency_code<>'8'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN age<=14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age<=29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END bucket, charge_amount FROM o)
SELECT bucket, count(*) claims, sum(charge_amount) billed FROM b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '0-14' THEN 1 WHEN '15-29' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

WITH f AS (SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) fs FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE fs>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND fs<DATE '2026-08-01' AND claim_key NOT IN (SELECT claim_key FROM sem.remit_claims)

WITH l AS (SELECT payer_name, payer_key, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount a FROM sem.remit_lines
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND units_paid=1 AND line_allowed_amount>0),
m AS (SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, a, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_key, procedure_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC, a DESC) rk FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3),
t AS (SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, a typ FROM m WHERE rk=1)
SELECT l.payer_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.a<t.typ) underpaid_lines, round(coalesce(sum(t.typ-l.a) FILTER (WHERE l.a<t.typ),0),2) shortfall

SELECT payer_class, month, n current_adjudications, d denied, round(100.0*d/n,2) rate_pct,
 round(100.0*d/n - lag(100.0*d/n) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY month),2) mom_pp FROM m ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='81479') / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount),0), 4) AS share

SELECT referring_npi, count(*) claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) denied, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied)/count(*),2) rate_pct
